title: Send a bounded local notice and retain its limits
goal: Deliver a short notice to the current guest console and distinguish delivery evidence from recipient comprehension or remote notification.
challenge: Record the guest TTY, time and a concise notice. Deliver it through the existing privileged wall command with a finite timeout and retain its actual exit status. Observe the console notice; explain what sender success cannot establish. No remote or login-policy changes.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/operations-notices.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && saved_umask=$(umask) && umask 077 && pwd && here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/operations-notices.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700 && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w"; }; dir_ok() { test -d "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(realpath -e -- "$1")" = "$w/$1"; }; fresh() { for f; do test ! -e "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || return 19; done; }; here && test "$(df --output=avail -k . | tail -1)" -gt 65536
steps.explanation: Create and record a new private guest workspace. Stop on any failed guard; the free-space check is an observation, not a guaranteed reserve. Do not use the host terminal.
steps.expected: A unique learner-owned mode0700 directory; no originals overwritten.

steps.command: here && fresh context.txt notice.txt sent.txt && { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; tty; id; } > context.txt && printf 'LL_PRACTICE_NOTICE: private guest exercise; no action required.\n' > notice.txt && test "$(stat -c %s notice.txt)" -le 128 && cat context.txt
steps.explanation: Local guest only; the console is the recipient in this isolated exercise. A small non-sensitive message and its context are retained.
steps.expected: TTY, UTC time, identity and a short explicit practice notice.

steps.command: here && test -f notice.txt && test ! -L notice.txt && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h notice.txt)" = learner:600:1 && test "$(stat -c %s notice.txt)" -le 128 && test "$(wc -l < notice.txt)" = 1 && { { test ! -e sent.txt && test ! -L sent.txt; } || { test -f sent.txt && test ! -L sent.txt && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h sent.txt)" = learner:600:1; }; } && printf '\033[2J\033[H' && { timeout -k 1s 5s sudo -n wall -n < notice.txt; rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$rc" > sent.txt; test "$rc" = 0; }
steps.explanation: On this Debian guest -n suppressing the banner requires root. The approved sudo privilege is guest-only. Observe the displayed message, not just its input file.
steps.expected: Actual visible LL_PRACTICE_NOTICE on this console; sender status0.

steps.command: here && test "$(cat sent.txt)" = 0 && test "$(wc -l < notice.txt)" = 1 && test "$(stat -c %U:%a notice.txt)" = learner:600
steps.explanation: Sender success and observed own-console delivery do not prove every recipient saw, understood or acted on the message. Do not add mesg/write or remote services.
steps.expected: Retained status and private message; self-reviewed delivery limitations.

hints: Separate actual console observation from sender exit status.
This is local guest communication, not network alerting.
review: I retained actual statuses, bytes and relevant identities, including the incorrect case; successful command exit alone is not my evidence.
I can explain the stated limitations and independently meet the Challenge outcomes. Completion records my self-review, not an automatic assessment.
I preserved originals and inspected the exact cleanup inventory before deleting only this recorded practice workspace.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 101.3 wall-tool preparation; not advance-notification assessment. Self-reviewed and unscored; no complete-objective, exam-readiness or LPI-endorsement claim.
